318 static void DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configCfarThreshScaleLUT
319 (
320  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg
321 )
322 {
323  uint32_t rangeIdx;
324  const float log2_10 = 3.3219F;
325  /* The first few range bins will have constant threshold */
326  float numConstThreshBinsRatio = 0.25F;
327  /* The constant threshold will be higher than the last bins threshold by: */
328  float nearBinsDiffdB = 7.0F;
329 
330  if(cfg->staticCfg.cfarCfg.variableThresholdMode != 0U)
331  {
332  for(rangeIdx = 0; rangeIdx < cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins; rangeIdx++)
333  {
334  if((float)rangeIdx < ((float)cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins * numConstThreshBinsRatio))
335  {
336  cfg->hwRes.cfarThreshScaleLUT[rangeIdx] = ((float)nearBinsDiffdB / 20.0F) * log2_10 * 2048.0F;
337  }
338  else
339  {
340  float linearThreshRatio = (1.0F - (((float)rangeIdx + 1.0F) / (float)cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins)) / (1.0F - numConstThreshBinsRatio);
341  cfg->hwRes.cfarThreshScaleLUT[rangeIdx] = linearThreshRatio * (nearBinsDiffdB / 20.0F) * log2_10 * 2048.0F;
342  }
343  }
344  }
345 }

457 static inline void DPU_DopplerProcHWA_ConfigShuffleLUT(uint16_t shuffleRAMBuf[], DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj,
458  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg,
459  uint32_t rangeBinIdx)
460 {
461  uint8_t * restrict dopMaxSubBandMat = (uint8_t *)cfg->hwRes.dopMaxSubBandScratchBuf[rangeBinIdx];
462  uint16_t numDopplerSubBins = obj->numDopplerBins / obj->dopplerDemodCfg.numBandsTotal;
463  uint16_t * restrict shuffleRAMPtr = shuffleRAMBuf + rangeBinIdx*numDopplerSubBins;
464  uint16_t mulOffset = numDopplerSubBins;
465  uint16_t dopSubIdx = 0;
466 
467  /* Populate Shuffle LUT RAM contents in array.
468  * Shuffle LUT is a 256 element vector (RAM) storing 12-bit numbers. Care should be taken that value should not exceed 2^!2-1. */
469  for(dopSubIdx = 0; dopSubIdx < numDopplerSubBins; dopSubIdx++)
470  {
471  shuffleRAMPtr[dopSubIdx] = (dopMaxSubBandMat[dopSubIdx] * mulOffset) + dopSubIdx;
472  }
473 }

493 static inline uint32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_updateSNRList(int32_t SNR, int32_t SNRList[], uint32_t maxNumobjPerRG)
494 {
495 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
496  (void)_nassert((int) SNRList % 8 == 0);
497 #endif
498  int32_t min2SNR[2];
499  uint32_t min2Loc[2];
500  uint32_t objIdx, minLoc, idx;
501  int32_t minSNR;
502  min2SNR[0] = SNRList[0];
503  min2SNR[1] = SNRList[1];
504  min2Loc[0] = 0;
505  min2Loc[1] = 1;
506 
507  for (objIdx = 2U; objIdx < maxNumobjPerRG; objIdx++)
508  {
509  idx = objIdx % 2U;
510  if(min2SNR[idx] > SNRList[objIdx])
511  {
512  min2SNR[idx] = SNRList[objIdx];
513  min2Loc[idx] = objIdx;
514  }
515  }
516 
517  if (min2SNR[0] > min2SNR[1])
518  {
519  minSNR = min2SNR[1];
520  minLoc = min2Loc[1];
521  }
522  else
523  {
524  minSNR = min2SNR[0];
525  minLoc = min2Loc[0];
526  }
527 
528  if (SNR > minSNR)
529  {
530  SNRList[minLoc] = SNR;
531  return minLoc;
532  }
533  else
534  {
535  return maxNumobjPerRG;
536  }
537 }
538 #endif

557 static int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj * restrict obj,
558  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config * restrict cfg,
559  uint32_t blockIdx,
560  uint32_t mergedOBIdx,
561  uint32_t rangeBinIdx)
562 {
563  uint8_t * restrict azimFFTMat;
564  uint32_t * restrict localMaxMat;
565  uint8_t * restrict dopSubMaxMat;
566  uint8_t * restrict dopFFTMat;
567  uint32_t baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(obj->edmaHandle);
568  uint32_t edmaSrcAddr, edmaDstAddr, edmaTrigReg, edmaIntrStatusReg, edmaClrIntrStatusReg, channelMask;
569 
570  uint32_t detObj=0, localMaxVal;
571  uint32_t DopIdxCurr, AzimIdx, AzimIdxCurr, CFARNoiseCurr, numRowsPerAzim;
572  uint32_t rowIdx, bit;
573  uint32_t azimPeakSamplem1, azimPeakSample, p1Idx, azimPeakSamplep1, dopFFTMatStartIdx;
574  DetObjParams * restrict currObjParams;
575  int32_t m1Idx, retVal = 0;
576  uint32_t numDopplerBinsPerSubBand = (obj->numDopplerBins / obj->dopplerDemodCfg.numBandsTotal);
577  uint32_t numBytesPerRDBin, subBandIdx;
578  uint32_t dopFFTBytesPerSample = DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_DOPPLERIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE;
579  uint32_t rangeIdx = (((blockIdx * obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks) + mergedOBIdx) * obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock) + rangeBinIdx;
580 
581 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
582  int32_t SNR;
583  uint32_t posIdx;
584  uint32_t numObjPerRangeGate = 0;
585  int32_t SNRList[MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN] __attribute__((aligned(8))) = {0};
586  uint32_t maxNumObjsCurRangeGate;
587 #endif
588 
589  /* Do not bother with objects in the first range bin. */
590  if(rangeIdx == 0U)
591  {
592  return retVal;
593  }
594 
595  if (obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
596  {
597  return retVal;
598  }
599 
600  numBytesPerRDBin = dopFFTBytesPerSample * cfg->staticCfg.numVirtualAntennas;
601  edmaSrcAddr = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT(cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.edmaDetObjAntSamples.channel) + 0x4U;
602  edmaDstAddr = edmaSrcAddr + 0x8U;
603  edmaTrigReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ESR_RN(0);
604  edmaIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_IPR_RN(0);
605  edmaClrIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ICR_RN(0);
606  channelMask = (uint32_t)1U << cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.edmaDetObjAntSamples.channel;
607 
608  /* Assign local matrix pointers based on ping/pong */
609  azimFFTMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PONG_OUT : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PING_OUT];
610  localMaxMat = (uint32_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_LOCALMAX_PONG_OUT : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_LOCALMAX_PING_OUT];
611  dopSubMaxMat = (uint8_t *) cfg->hwRes.dopMaxSubBandScratchBuf[rangeBinIdx % 2U];
612  numRowsPerAzim = (obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins % 32U == 0U) ?
613  (obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins / 32U) : (obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins / 32U) + 1U;
614  dopFFTMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PONG_IN : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PING_IN];
615 
616 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
617  maxNumObjsCurRangeGate = (((cfg->hwRes.maxObjListPerRGateSize) * (rangeIdx + 1U)) - (obj->numObjOut * sizeof(DetObjParams))) / sizeof(DetObjParams);
618  /* Following is required to ensure local array SNRList in DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList does not overflow.
619  * This also allows user to set a lower limit for object detection per range gate, if desired. */
620  if (maxNumObjsCurRangeGate > MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN)
621  {
622  maxNumObjsCurRangeGate = MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN;
623  }
624 #endif
625  /* This field is not populated when histogram is enabled. Setting it zero.*/
626  CFARNoiseCurr = 0;
627  /* Loop through CFAR peaks and check whether an object is present for a particular peak. If it is present,
628  store its parameters in the output list */
629  for(rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < numDopplerBinsPerSubBand * numRowsPerAzim; rowIdx++)
630  {
631  if(localMaxMat[rowIdx])
632  {
633  localMaxVal = localMaxMat[rowIdx];
634  DopIdxCurr = floor(rowIdx / numRowsPerAzim);
635  AzimIdx = 32U * (rowIdx - (numRowsPerAzim * DopIdxCurr));
636 
637  while(localMaxVal != 0)
638  {
639 #ifdef SUBSYS_M4
640  bit = __clz(__rbit(localMaxVal));
641 #elif defined(SUBSYS_DSS)
642  bit = _lmbd(1, _bitr(localMaxVal));
643 #endif
644  /* Clear the bit */
645  localMaxVal &= ~((uint32_t)1U << bit);
646 
647  AzimIdxCurr = AzimIdx + bit;
648 
649  /* Extract the signal power. */
650  azimPeakSample = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[(AzimIdxCurr + DopIdxCurr * obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins)
651  * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
652 
653 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
654  /* We have a common peak. Now, check to see if there is space
655  * in this range gate for this peak. It should be one of
656  * the largest MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN peaks in the range-
657  * gate. */
658 
659  /* Compute the SNR w.r.t to the CFAR noise. */
660  SNR = (int32_t) azimPeakSample - (int32_t)CFARNoiseCurr;
661 
662  /* Check if it is one of highest MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN SNR
663  * object in the range bin. If it is, update the SNRlist with
664  * that position, and return the position. */
665  if (numObjPerRangeGate < maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
666  {
667  posIdx = numObjPerRangeGate;
668  SNRList[posIdx] = SNR;
669  }
670  else
671  {
672  posIdx = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_updateSNRList(SNR, SNRList, maxNumObjsCurRangeGate);
673  if(posIdx == maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
674  {
675  continue;
676  }
677  }
678 
679  currObjParams = &cfg->hwRes.detObjList[obj->numObjOut + posIdx];
680 #else
681  currObjParams = &cfg->hwRes.detObjList[obj->numObjOut];
682 #endif
683  /* Object found */
684  /* Place all parameters it in its alloted position. */
685  currObjParams->azimIdx = AzimIdxCurr;
686  currObjParams->dopIdx = DopIdxCurr;
687  currObjParams->rangeIdx = rangeIdx;
688  subBandIdx = (uint32_t )dopSubMaxMat[DopIdxCurr];
689  currObjParams->dopIdxActual = DopIdxCurr + (subBandIdx * numDopplerBinsPerSubBand);
690  if (currObjParams->dopIdxActual > obj->numDopplerBins)
691  {
692  currObjParams->dopIdxActual -= obj->numDopplerBins;
693  }
694  /* Note that CFARNoise (the parameter to which the CUT is compared against) is not used anywhere else. */
695  currObjParams->dopCfarNoise = CFARNoiseCurr;
696 
697  dopFFTMatStartIdx = DopIdxCurr * numBytesPerRDBin;
698 
699  /* Obtain doppler FFT samples corresponding to the azimuth antenna samples. */
700 
701  /* Check the completion of previous transfer before triggering the next. */
702  if(detObj > 0U)
703  {
704  /* Check the interrupt status */
705  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
706  {
707  /* Wait for completion */
708  }
709  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
710  }
711 
712  /* Store the antenna samples */
713 
714  /* update src address */
715  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaSrcAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&dopFFTMat[dopFFTMatStartIdx]);
716 
717  /* update dst address */
718  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaDstAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&currObjParams->azimSamples[0]);
719 
720  /* trigger */
721  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaTrigReg) = channelMask;
722  detObj++;
723 
724  /* Obtain the azim values at and around the peak */
725  /* m1Idx is the index before the peak. */
726  m1Idx = ((int32_t)AzimIdxCurr) - 1;
727  if (m1Idx < 0)
728  {
729  m1Idx = (int32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins - 1;
730  }
731  /* p1Idx is the index after the peak. */
732  p1Idx = (AzimIdxCurr + 1U);
733  if (p1Idx >= obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins)
734  {
735  p1Idx = 0U;
736  }
737 
738  azimPeakSamplem1 = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[(m1Idx + DopIdxCurr * obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins)
739  * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
740  azimPeakSamplep1 = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[(p1Idx + DopIdxCurr * obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins)
741  * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
742  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[0] = azimPeakSamplem1;
743  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[1] = azimPeakSample;
744  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[2] = azimPeakSamplep1;
745 
746 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
747  numObjPerRangeGate++;
748  if (numObjPerRangeGate > maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
749  {
750  numObjPerRangeGate = maxNumObjsCurRangeGate;
751  }
752 
753  if (numObjPerRangeGate + obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
754  {
755  obj->numObjOut += numObjPerRangeGate;
756  goto exit;
757  }
758 #else
759  obj->numObjOut++;
760  /* If we have no more space for new objects, return. */
761  if (obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
762  {
763  goto exit;
764  }
765 #endif
766  } /* end of bits set per row loop*/
767  } /* end of if condn */
768  } /* end of rows traversal loop */
769 
770 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
771  obj->numObjOut+= numObjPerRangeGate;
772 #endif
773 
774 exit:
775  /* Monitor the completion of last transfer here. */
776  if(detObj > 0)
777  {
778  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
779  {
780  /* wait for completion */
781  }
782  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
783  }
784  return retVal;
785 }
786 
787 #else
788 
804 static int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj * restrict obj,
805  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config * restrict cfg,
806  uint32_t blockIdx,
807  uint32_t mergedOBIdx,
808  uint32_t rangeBinIdx)
809 {
810  uint8_t * restrict azimFFTMat;
811  uint8_t * restrict cfarMat;
812  uint8_t * restrict localMaxMat;
813  uint8_t * restrict dopSubMaxMat;
814  uint8_t * restrict dopFFTMat;
815  uint32_t baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(obj->edmaHandle);
816  uint32_t edmaSrcAddr, edmaDstAddr, edmaTrigReg, edmaIntrStatusReg, edmaClrIntrStatusReg, channelMask;
817 
818  uint32_t i, detObj=0; //numTxAntAzim, numTxAntElev,
819  uint32_t numCfarPeaks, DopIdxCurr, AzimIdxCurr, CFARNoiseCurr, numRowsPerAzim;
820  uint32_t RowIdx, BitIdx, rowVal, bit, cfarResReal, cfarResImag;
821  uint32_t azimPeakSamplem1, azimPeakSample, p1Idx, azimPeakSamplep1, dopFFTMatStartIdx;
822  DetObjParams * restrict currObjParams;
823  int32_t m1Idx, retVal = 0;
824  uint32_t cfarPeaksToLoop;
825  uint32_t numDopplerBinsPerSubBand = (uint32_t)obj->numDopplerBins / (uint32_t)obj->dopplerDemodCfg.numBandsTotal;
826  uint32_t numBytesPerRDBin, subBandIdx;
827  uint32_t dopFFTBytesPerSample = DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_DOPPLERIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE;
828  uint32_t rangeIdx = (((blockIdx * obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks) + mergedOBIdx) * obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock) + rangeBinIdx;
829 
830 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
831  int32_t SNR;
832  uint32_t posIdx;
833  uint32_t numObjPerRangeGate = 0;
834  int32_t SNRList[MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN] __attribute__((aligned(8))) = {0};
835  uint32_t maxNumObjsCurRangeGate;
836 #endif
837 
838  /* Do not bother with objects in the first range bin. */
839  if(rangeIdx == 0U)
840  {
841  return retVal;
842  }
843 
844  if (obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
845  {
846  return retVal;
847  }
848 
849  numBytesPerRDBin = dopFFTBytesPerSample * cfg->staticCfg.numVirtualAntennas;
850  edmaSrcAddr = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT(cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.edmaDetObjAntSamples.channel) + 0x4U;
851  edmaDstAddr = edmaSrcAddr + 0x8U;
852  edmaTrigReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ESR_RN(0U);
853  edmaIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_IPR_RN(0U);
854  edmaClrIntrStatusReg = baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_ICR_RN(0U);
855  channelMask = (uint32_t)1U << cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.edmaDetObjAntSamples.channel;
856 
857  if(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 0U)
858  {
859  numCfarPeaks = obj->numCfarPeaksPing;
860  }
861  else
862  {
863  numCfarPeaks = obj->numCfarPeaksPong;
864  }
865 
866  /* Assign local matrix pointers based on ping/pong */
867  azimFFTMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PONG_OUT : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PING_OUT];
868  cfarMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_CFAR_PONG_OUT : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_CFAR_PING_OUT];
869  localMaxMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_LOCALMAX_PONG_OUT : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_LOCALMAX_PING_OUT];
870  dopSubMaxMat = (uint8_t *) cfg->hwRes.dopMaxSubBandScratchBuf[((rangeBinIdx % 2U) == 0U) ? 0U : 1U];
871  numRowsPerAzim = (obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins % 32U == 0U) ?
872  ((uint32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins / 32U) : ((uint32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins / 32U) + 1U;
873  dopFFTMat = (uint8_t *) obj->hwaMemBankAddr[(rangeBinIdx % 2U == 1U) ? DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PONG_IN : DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_MEM_BANK_AZIMFFT_PING_IN];
874 
875  cfarPeaksToLoop = (numCfarPeaks > cfg->hwRes.maxCfarPeaksToDetect) ? cfg->hwRes.maxCfarPeaksToDetect : numCfarPeaks;
876 
877 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
878  maxNumObjsCurRangeGate = (((cfg->hwRes.maxObjListPerRGateSize) * (rangeIdx + 1U)) - (obj->numObjOut * sizeof(DetObjParams))) / sizeof(DetObjParams);
879  /* Following is required to ensure local array SNRList in DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList does not overflow.
880  * This also allows user to set a lower limit for object detection per range gate, if desired. */
881  if (maxNumObjsCurRangeGate > MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN)
882  {
883  maxNumObjsCurRangeGate = MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN;
884  }
885 #endif
886 
887  /* Loop through CFAR peaks and check whether an object is present for a particular peak. If it is present,
888  store its parameters in the output list */
889  for(i = 0; i < cfarPeaksToLoop; i++)
890  {
891  /* To get the real and imag part */
892  cfarResImag = *(uint32_t *)(&cfarMat[i * sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t)]);
893  cfarResReal = *(uint32_t *)(&cfarMat[(i * sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t)) + sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t)/2U]);
894  CFARNoiseCurr = cfarResImag;
895 
896  AzimIdxCurr = (cfarResReal) >> 12;
897  DopIdxCurr = (cfarResReal) - (AzimIdxCurr << 12);
898 
899  if(DopIdxCurr > numDopplerBinsPerSubBand)
900  {
901  continue;
902  }
903 
904  RowIdx = (DopIdxCurr * numRowsPerAzim) + (AzimIdxCurr / 32U);
905  BitIdx = AzimIdxCurr - 32U * (AzimIdxCurr / 32U);
906 
907  rowVal = *(uint32_t *)(&localMaxMat[RowIdx * sizeof(uint32_t)]);
908  bit = EXTRACT_BIT(rowVal, BitIdx);
909 
910  if(bit != 0U)
911  {
912  /* Extract the signal power. */
913  azimPeakSample = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[(AzimIdxCurr + DopIdxCurr * obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins) * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
914 
915 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
916  /* We have a common peak. Now, check to see if there is space
917  * in this range gate for this peak. It should be one of
918  * the largest MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN peaks in the range-
919  * gate. */
920 
921  /* Compute the SNR w.r.t to the CFAR noise. */
922  SNR = (int32_t) azimPeakSample - (int32_t)CFARNoiseCurr;
923 
924  /* Check if it is one of highest MAX_NUM_OBJ_PER_RANGE_BIN SNR
925  * object in the range bin. If it is, update the SNRlist with
926  * that position, and return the position. */
927  if (numObjPerRangeGate < maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
928  {
929  posIdx = numObjPerRangeGate;
930  SNRList[posIdx] = SNR;
931  }
932  else
933  {
934  posIdx = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_updateSNRList(SNR, SNRList, maxNumObjsCurRangeGate);
935  if(posIdx == maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
936  {
937  continue;
938  }
939  }
940 
941  currObjParams = &cfg->hwRes.detObjList[obj->numObjOut + posIdx];
942 #else
943  currObjParams = &cfg->hwRes.detObjList[obj->numObjOut];
944 #endif
945  /* Object found */
946  /* Place all parameters it in its alloted position. */
947  currObjParams->azimIdx = AzimIdxCurr;
948  currObjParams->dopIdx = DopIdxCurr;
949  currObjParams->rangeIdx = rangeIdx;
950  subBandIdx = (uint32_t )dopSubMaxMat[DopIdxCurr];
951  currObjParams->dopIdxActual = (DopIdxCurr + (subBandIdx * numDopplerBinsPerSubBand));
952  if (currObjParams->dopIdxActual > obj->numDopplerBins)
953  {
954  currObjParams->dopIdxActual -= obj->numDopplerBins;
955  }
956  /* Note that CFARNoise (the parameter to which the CUT is compared against) is not used anywhere else. */
957  currObjParams->dopCfarNoise = CFARNoiseCurr;
958 
959  dopFFTMatStartIdx = DopIdxCurr * numBytesPerRDBin;
960 
961  /* Obtain doppler FFT samples corresponding to the azimuth antenna samples. */
962 
963  /* Check the completion of previous transfer before triggering the next. */
964  if(detObj > 0U)
965  {
966  /* Check the interrupt status */
967  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
968  {
969  /* Wait for the transfer to complete. */
970  }
971  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
972  }
973 
974  /* Store the antenna samples */
975 
976  /* update src address */
977  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaSrcAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&dopFFTMat[dopFFTMatStartIdx]);
978 
979  /* update dst address */
980  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaDstAddr) = (uint32_t)SOC_virtToPhy((void*)&currObjParams->azimSamples[0]);
981 
982  /* trigger */
983  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaTrigReg) = channelMask;
984  detObj++;
985 
986  /* Obtain the azim values at and around the peak */
987  /* m1Idx is the index before the peak. */
988  m1Idx = (int32_t)AzimIdxCurr - 1;
989  if (m1Idx < 0)
990  {
991  m1Idx = (int32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins-1;
992  }
993  /* p1Idx is the index after the peak. */
994  p1Idx = (AzimIdxCurr + 1U);
995  if (p1Idx >= obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins)
996  {
997  p1Idx = 0U;
998  }
999 
1000  azimPeakSamplem1 = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[((uint32_t)m1Idx + DopIdxCurr * (uint32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins) * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
1001  azimPeakSamplep1 = *(uint16_t *)(&azimFFTMat[((uint32_t)p1Idx + DopIdxCurr * (uint32_t)obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.numAzimFFTBins) * DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_AZIMFFTIO_OUTPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE]);
1002  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[0] = azimPeakSamplem1;
1003  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[1] = azimPeakSample;
1004  currObjParams->azimPeakSamples[2] = azimPeakSamplep1;
1005 
1006 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
1007  numObjPerRangeGate++;
1008  if (numObjPerRangeGate > maxNumObjsCurRangeGate)
1009  {
1010  numObjPerRangeGate = maxNumObjsCurRangeGate;
1011  }
1012 
1013  if (numObjPerRangeGate + obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
1014  {
1015  obj->numObjOut += numObjPerRangeGate;
1016  goto exit;
1017  }
1018 #else
1019  obj->numObjOut++;
1020  /* If we have no more space for new objects, return. */
1021  if (obj->numObjOut >= cfg->staticCfg.maxNumObj)
1022  {
1023  goto exit;
1024  }
1025 #endif
1026  }
1027  }
1028 #ifdef LIMIT_DETECTED_OBJS_PER_RANGEBIN
1029  obj->numObjOut+= numObjPerRangeGate;
1030 #endif
1031 
1032 exit:
1033  /* Monitor the completion of last transfer here. */
1034  if(detObj > 0U)
1035  {
1036  while(((*(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaIntrStatusReg)) & (channelMask)) != (channelMask))
1037  {
1038  /* Wait for the transfer to complete. */
1039  }
1040  *(volatile uint32_t*)((uint32_t)edmaClrIntrStatusReg) = channelMask;
1041  }
1042  return retVal;
1043 }
1044 #endif

1058 static int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configHwaDecompression
1059 (
1060  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj,
1061  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg
1062 )
1063 {
1064  HWA_ParamConfig hwaParamCfg;

1074

1085 
1086  (void)memset((void*) &hwaParamCfg, 0, sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
1087 
1088  /********************************************************************************/
1089 
1090  /*******************************/
1091  /* PING DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET */
1092  /*******************************/
1093 {{
1094  /* adcbuf not mapped, HWA is triggered after edma copy is done */
1095  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
1096  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pingHwParamsetIdx;
1097 
1098  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_COMPRESS;
1099 
1100  /* ACCELMODE CONFIG */
1101 #if defined(DATAPATH_TEST) || defined(OBJ_DETECTION_DDMA_TEST)
1102  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.ditherEnable = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE; // Disable dither for datapath bit-exact test
1103 #else

1105 #endif
1106  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.compressDecompress = HWA_CMP_DCMP_DECOMPRESS;
1107  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.method = pDPDecompParams->compressionMethod;

1112  /* SRC CONFIG */
1113  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PING_IN;
1114 
1115  hwaParamCfg.source.srcRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_COMPLEX;
1116  hwaParamCfg.source.srcWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT;
1117  hwaParamCfg.source.srcSign = HWA_SAMPLES_UNSIGNED;
1118  hwaParamCfg.source.srcConjugate = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE;
1119  hwaParamCfg.source.srcScale = 0;
1120 
1121  /* DEST CONFIG */

1123

1130 
1131  if (pDPDecompParams->compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)

1133  /***************************************/
1134  /* PING BFP DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET RX1 */
1135  /***************************************/
1136 
1137  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.BFPMantissaBW = (uint8_t)((pDPDecompParams->inputBytesPerBlock * 8U -
1138  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.compressMode.scaleFactorBW) /
1139  (pDPDecompParams->outputSamplesPerBlock * 2U));
1140 
1141  /* SRC CONFIG */
1142  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = pDPDecompParams->inputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;
1143  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->bytesPerSample;

1145  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->inputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->rxAntPerBlock;
1146 
1147  /* DEST CONFIG */
1148  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAcnt = pDPDecompParams->outputSamplesPerBlock - 1U;

1150  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->outputBytesPerBlock * (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->rxAntPerBlock;
1151 
1152  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1153  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1154  &hwaParamCfg,NULL);

1160  /***************************************/

1166 
1167  /* SRC CONFIG */

1169 
1170  /* DEST CONFIG */
1171  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PONG_OUT;
1172 
1173  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1174  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1175  &hwaParamCfg,NULL);
1176  if (errCode != 0)
1177  {
1178  goto exit;
1179  }
1180 
1181  for (rxAntIdx = 1; rxAntIdx < pDPDecompParams->rxAntPerBlock; rxAntIdx++)
1182  {
1183  /***************************************/
1184  /* PING BFP DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET RXN */
1185  /***************************************/
1186  pingHwParamsetIdx++;
1187  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1188  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PING_IN + (uint32_t)rxAntIdx * (uint32_t)pDPDecompParams->inputBytesPerBlock;
1189  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PING_OUT + (uint32_t)rxAntIdx * (uint32_t)pDPDecompParams->bytesPerSample;
1190  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1191  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1192  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1193  if (errCode != 0)
1194  {
1195  goto exit;
1196  }
1197 
1198  /***************************************/
1199  /* PONG BFP DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET RXN */
1200  /***************************************/
1201  pongHwParamsetIdx++;
1202  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_IMMEDIATE;
1203  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PONG_IN + (uint32_t)rxAntIdx * (uint32_t)pDPDecompParams->inputBytesPerBlock;
1204  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PONG_OUT + (uint32_t)rxAntIdx * (uint32_t)pDPDecompParams->bytesPerSample;
1205  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1206  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1207  &hwaParamCfg,NULL);
1208  if (errCode != 0)
1209  {
1210  goto exit;
1211  }
1212  }
1213  }
1214 
1215  else if(pDPDecompParams->compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_EGE)
1216  {
1217  /***********************************/
1218  /* PING EGE DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET */

1222  /* SRC CONFIG */

1224  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->bytesPerSample;

1226  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->inputBytesPerBlock;
1227 
1228  /* DEST CONFIG */

1230  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->bytesPerSample;
1231  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)pDPDecompParams->outputBytesPerBlock;
1232 
1233  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1234  pingHwParamsetIdx,
1235  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
1236  if (errCode != 0)
1237  {
1238  goto exit;
1239  }
1240 
1241  /***********************************/
1242  /* PONG EGE DECOMPRESSION PARAMSET */
1243  /***********************************/
1244  /* adcbuf not mapped, HWA is triggered after edma copy is done */
1245  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
1246  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = pongHwParamsetIdx;
1247 
1248  /* SRC CONFIG */
1249  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PONG_IN;
1250 
1251  /* DEST CONFIG */
1252  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = (uint32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_ADDR_DECOMP_PONG_OUT;
1253 
1254  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
1255  pongHwParamsetIdx,
1256  &hwaParamCfg,NULL);
1257  if (errCode != 0)
1258  {
1259  goto exit;
1260  }
1261  }
1262  else
1263  {
1264  /* There is no other valid case. */
1265  DebugP_assert(0);
1266  }
1267 
1268  errCode = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaOut.pingPong[PING].channel, &destChanPing);
1269  if (errCode != 0)
1270  {
1271  goto exit;
1272  }
1273  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
1274  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
1275  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPing;
1276  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(obj->hwaHandle, pingHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
1277  if (errCode != 0)
1278  {
1279  goto exit;
1280  }
1281 
1282  errCode = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaOut.pingPong[PONG].channel, &destChanPing);
1283  if (errCode != 0)
1284  {
1285  goto exit;
1286  }
1287  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
1288  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
1289  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPing;
1290  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(obj->hwaHandle, pongHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
1291  if (errCode != 0)
1292  {
1293  goto exit;
1294  }
1295  }}
1296 
1297 exit:
1298  return(errCode);
1299 }

1415  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = cfg->staticCfg.numChirps - 1U; /* this is samples - 1 */
1416  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)cfg->staticCfg.numRxAntennas * (int32_t)DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_DOPPLERIO_INPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE;

2321  }

3144 DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Handle DPU_DopplerProcHWA_init
3145 (
3146  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_InitParams *initCfg,
3147  volatile uint8_t subframeCounter,
3148  int32_t *errCode
3149 )
3150 {
3151  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj = NULL;
3152  HWA_MemInfo hwaMemInfo;
3153  uint32_t index;
3154 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
3155  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
3156 #endif
3157 
3158  *errCode = 0;
3159 
3160  if((initCfg == NULL) || (initCfg->hwaHandle == NULL))
3161  {
3162  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_EINVAL;
3163  goto exit;
3164  }
3165 
3166  DebugP_assert(subframeCounter < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES);
3167 
3168  obj = (DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *)&dopplerProcObjPool;
3169 
3170  /* Initialize memory */
3171  (void)memset((void *)obj, 0, sizeof(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj));
3172 
3173  /* Save init config params */
3174  obj->hwaHandle = initCfg->hwaHandle;
3175 
3176  /* Creating semaphores */
3177  {{
3178 
3179 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
3180  /* Create semaphore for HWA decompression done */
3181  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->decompEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, 0);
3182  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3183  {
3184  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3185  goto exit;
3186  }
3187  /* Create semaphore for HWA Demodulation done */
3188  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->demodHwaDoneSemaHandle, 0);
3189  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3190  {
3191  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3192  goto exit;
3193  }
3194 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
3195  /* Create semaphore for HWA CFAR done */
3196  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->cfarHwaDoneSemaHandle, 0);
3197  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3198  {
3199  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3200  goto exit;
3201  }
3202 #endif
3203 
3204  for(index = 0U; index < 2U; index++)
3205  {
3206  /* Create semaphore for HWA DDMA Metric done */
3207  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->maxSubbandEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle[index], 0);
3208  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3209  {
3210  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3211  goto exit;
3212  }
3213 
3214 
3215 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
3216  /* Create semaphore for HWA azimuth FFT done */
3217  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->azimFFTHwaDoneSemaHandle[index], 0);
3218  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3219  {
3220  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3221  goto exit;
3222  }
3223 #endif
3224 
3225  /* Create semaphore for HWA local max done */
3226  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->localMaxHwaDoneSemaHandle[index], 0);
3227  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
3228  {
3229  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMA;
3230  goto exit;
3231  }
3232  }
3233 #endif
3234  }}
3235 
3236  /* Populate HWA base addresses and offsets. This is done only once, at init time.*/
3237  *errCode = HWA_getHWAMemInfo(obj->hwaHandle, &hwaMemInfo);
3238  if (*errCode < 0)
3239  {
3240  goto exit;
3241  }
3242 
3243  /* check if we have enough memory banks*/
3244  if(hwaMemInfo.numBanks < DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_MEMBANKS)
3245  {
3246  *errCode = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_EHWARES;
3247  goto exit;
3248  }
3249 
3250  for (index = 0U; index < DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_MEMBANKS; index++)
3251  {
3252  obj->hwaMemBankAddr[index] = hwaMemInfo.baseAddress + (index * hwaMemInfo.bankSize);
3253  }
3254 
3255 exit:
3256  if(*errCode < 0)
3257  {
3258  if(obj != NULL)
3259  {
3260  obj = NULL;
3261  }
3262  }
3263  return ((DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Handle)obj);
3264 }

3282 int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_config
3283 (
3284  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Handle handle,
3285  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg,
3286  int32_t isFullCfg
3287 )
3288 {
3289  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj;
3290  int32_t retVal = 0;
3291  float temp;
3292 
3293  obj = (DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *)handle;
3294  if((obj == NULL) || (cfg==NULL))
3295  {
3296  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_EINVAL;
3297  goto exit;
3298  }
3299 
3300  if (isFullCfg == 1)
3301  {
3302  obj->edmaHandle = cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.edmaHandle;
3303 
3304  obj->numDopplerChirps = cfg->staticCfg.numChirps;
3305  obj->numDopplerBins = (uint16_t)mathUtils_getValidFFTSize(cfg->staticCfg.numChirps);
3306 
3307  /* Decompression params */
3308  {{
3309  obj->decompCfg.isEnabled = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.isEnabled;
3310 
3311  obj->decompCfg.compressionMethod = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.compressionMethod;
3312  obj->decompCfg.bytesPerSample = (uint16_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
3313  obj->decompCfg.rxAntPerBlock = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.numRxAntennaPerBlock;
3314  obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3315  if(obj->decompCfg.compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
3316  {
3317  obj->decompCfg.outputSamplesPerBlock = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3318  }
3319  else
3320  {
3321  obj->decompCfg.outputSamplesPerBlock = obj->decompCfg.rxAntPerBlock * cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3322  }
3323  obj->decompCfg.outputBytesPerBlock = obj->decompCfg.outputSamplesPerBlock * obj->decompCfg.bytesPerSample;
3324  obj->decompCfg.numBlocks = cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins * cfg->staticCfg.numRxAntennas / obj->decompCfg.outputSamplesPerBlock;
3325  temp = (((cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.compressionRatio * (float)obj->decompCfg.outputBytesPerBlock) + 3.99F) / 4.0F);
3326  obj->decompCfg.inputBytesPerBlock = (uint16_t)temp * 4U; /* Word aligned */
3327  obj->decompCfg.inputSamplesPerBlock = obj->decompCfg.inputBytesPerBlock / obj->decompCfg.bytesPerSample;
3328  obj->decompCfg.achievedCompressionRatio = (float) obj->decompCfg.inputBytesPerBlock / (float)obj->decompCfg.outputBytesPerBlock;
3329  obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress = (void *)cfg->hwRes.radarCube.data;
3330  if (obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock < 8U)
3331  {
3332  obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks = 8U / (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock;
3333  }
3334  else
3335  {
3336  obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks = 1U;
3337  }
3338 
3339  if(obj->decompCfg.compressionMethod == HWA_COMPRESS_METHOD_BFP)
3340  {

3342  (uint16_t)obj->decompCfg.rxAntPerBlock * (uint16_t)obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks);

3346  {

3348  }

3350  (uint32_t)cfg->staticCfg.numChirps * (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks;

3355  * (uint16_t)obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks);
3356 
3357  /* dstCIdx of DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configEdmaDecompressionOut must be less that 32768 */
3358  if((obj->decompCfg.numChirpsPerPing * obj->decompCfg.outputBytesPerBlock * 2U) >= 32768U)

3363  (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks;
3364  }

3366  obj->decompCfg.numOuterBlocks = (cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins / (cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock * obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks)) ;

3370  {
3371  obj->decompCfg.numLoops = (cfg->staticCfg.numChirps / obj->decompCfg.numChirpsPerPing);
3372  if((obj->decompCfg.numLoops % 2U) == 0U)
3373  {
3374  obj->decompCfg.numLoops = obj->decompCfg.numLoops / 2U;
3375  }
3376  }
3377  else
3378  {
3379  obj->decompCfg.numLoops = (cfg->staticCfg.numChirps / obj->decompCfg.numChirpsPerPing) + 1U;

3382  obj->decompCfg.numLoops = obj->decompCfg.numLoops / 2U;
3383  }
3384  }
3385  if(obj->decompCfg.numLoops < 1U)

3388  }
3389 
3390  obj->decompCfg.numChirpsPerPing = cfg->staticCfg.numChirps / (obj->decompCfg.numLoops * 2U);

3660 static inline void DPU_DopplerProcHwa_configLocalMaxThresh(DSSHWACCRegs * restrict ctrlBaseAddr, uint16_t numAzimFFTBins)
3661 {
3662  uint32_t * restrict CDFThresholdRam = ( uint32_t *)HWA_HIST_THRESH_RAM_U_BASE;
3663  uint32_t * restrict maxValRam = ( uint32_t *)HWA_2DSTAT_SMPL_VAL_RAM;
3664  uint16_t * restrict histRam = ( uint16_t *)HWA_HIST_RAM_U_BASE;
3665 
3666  uint8_t azimBin;
3667  uint32_t cdfBin, CDFThreshRamVal;
3668  uint32_t histVal = 0;
3669  uint32_t histRamOffset = 1U << HIST_SIZE_SELECT;
3670  uint32_t den;
3671  uint32_t num;
3672  uint16_t histVal1;
3673 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3674  float interpolatedCDFBin;
3675  uint32_t histScale = 1U << HIST_SCALE_SELECT;
3676 #elif defined SUBSYS_M4
3677  uint32_t interpolatedCDFBin;
3678 #endif
3679 
3680  /* Read order is different in case of 48 histograms */
3681  if( numAzimFFTBins == 48U)
3682  {
3683  /* Read CDF result. */
3684  for(azimBin= 0; azimBin < 24; azimBin++)
3685  {
3686  CDFThreshRamVal = *CDFThresholdRam;
3687  /* CDF Bin Number Bits: 29:24 */
3688  cdfBin = CDFThreshRamVal >> 24U;
3689  /* Hist Val Bits: 11:0 */
3690  histVal = CDFThreshRamVal & 0xFFFU;
3691  /* Histogram Value at the next bin */
3692  histVal1 = *(histRam + cdfBin + 1U);
3693 
3694  /* Linear interpolation of the CDF Bin
3695  * interpolatedCDFBin = ((cdfBin * histVal) + ((cdfBin+1) * histVal1)) /(histVal + histVal1) */
3696  den = histVal + histVal1;
3697 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3698  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1);
3699  interpolatedCDFBin = divsp(num, den);
3700  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = (uint32_t)(interpolatedCDFBin * histScale);
3701 #elif defined(SUBSYS_M4)
3702  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1) << HIST_SCALE_SELECT;
3703  interpolatedCDFBin = num / den;
3704  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = interpolatedCDFBin;
3705 #endif
3706  CDFThresholdRam++;
3707  maxValRam++;
3708  histRam += histRamOffset;
3709  }
3710 
3711  CDFThresholdRam = ( uint32_t *)HWA_HIST_THRESH_RAM_U_BASE;
3712  CDFThresholdRam += 32U;
3713 
3714  histRam = ( uint16_t *)HWA_HIST_RAM_U_BASE;
3715  histRam += (32U << HIST_SIZE_SELECT);
3716 
3717  for(azimBin= 0; azimBin < 24U; azimBin++)
3718  {
3719  CDFThreshRamVal = *CDFThresholdRam;
3720  /* CDF Bin Number Bits: 29:24 */
3721  cdfBin = CDFThreshRamVal >> 24U;
3722  /* Hist Val Bits: 11:0 */
3723  histVal = CDFThreshRamVal & 0xFFFU;
3724  /* Histogram Value at the next bin */
3725  histVal1 = *(histRam + cdfBin + 1U);
3726 
3727  /* Linear interpolation of the CDF Bin
3728  * interpolatedCDFBin = ((cdfBin * histVal) + ((cdfBin+1) * histVal1)) /(histVal + histVal1) */
3729  den = histVal + histVal1;
3730 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3731  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1);
3732  interpolatedCDFBin = divsp(num, den);
3733  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = (uint32_t)(interpolatedCDFBin * histScale);
3734 #elif defined(SUBSYS_M4)
3735  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1) << HIST_SCALE_SELECT;
3736  interpolatedCDFBin = num / den;
3737  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = interpolatedCDFBin;
3738 #endif
3739  CDFThresholdRam++;
3740  maxValRam++;
3741  histRam += histRamOffset;
3742  }
3743  }
3744  else
3745  {
3746  for(azimBin= 0; azimBin < numAzimFFTBins; azimBin++)
3747  {
3748  CDFThreshRamVal = *CDFThresholdRam;
3749  /* CDF Bin Number Bits: 29:24 */
3750  cdfBin = CDFThreshRamVal >> 24U;
3751  /* Hist Val Bits: 11:0 */
3752  histVal = CDFThreshRamVal & 0xFFFU;
3753  /* Histogram Value at the next bin */
3754  histVal1 = *(histRam + cdfBin + 1U);
3755 
3756  /* Linear interpolation of the CDF Bin
3757  * interpolatedCDFBin = ((cdfBin * histVal) + ((cdfBin+1) * histVal1)) /(histVal + histVal1) */
3758  den = histVal + histVal1;
3759 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
3760  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1);
3761  interpolatedCDFBin = divsp(num, den);
3762  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = (uint32_t)(interpolatedCDFBin * histScale);
3763 #elif defined(SUBSYS_M4)
3764  num = ((cdfBin * den) + histVal1) << HIST_SCALE_SELECT;
3765  interpolatedCDFBin = num / den;
3766  *((uint32_t *)maxValRam) = interpolatedCDFBin;
3767 #endif
3768  CDFThresholdRam++;
3769  maxValRam++;
3770  histRam += histRamOffset;
3771  }
3772 
3773  }
3774 }
3775 #endif

3792 static inline int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configHWACommon
3793 (

3867  }

3878  (int32_t)round((double)(HIST_DOPPLER_DIM_OFFSET_DB)* ((1.0/20.0) * CONST_LOG2_10 * 2048.0)));
3879  if (retVal != 0)

3882  }

3885  (int32_t)-round((double)(obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.localMaxCfg.dopplerThreshold) * ((1.0 / 20.0) * CONST_LOG2_10 * 2048.0)));
3886  if (retVal != 0)
3887  {
3888  goto exit;
3889  }
3890  if(obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.cfarCfg->variableThresholdMode != 0U)
3891  {
3892  /* Variable CFAR Threshold Mode: Apply range-dependent threshold
3893  *
3894  * Initialize the CFAR threshold for range bin 0 (first bin to be processed).
3895  * DPU_DopplerProcHWA_getRangeDependentCfarThreshold() returns the final threshold
3896  * value by adding the baseline thresholdScale to the range-dependent offset from
3897  * cfarThreshScaleLUT (typically +7dB for near-field bins).
3898  *
3899  * The threshold will be dynamically updated for each subsequent range bin during
3900  * the processing loop to maintain optimal detection sensitivity across all ranges.
3901  */
3902  retVal = HWA_configCFARThresholdScale(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_getRangeDependentCfarThreshold(cfg, 0U));
3903  }
3904  else
3905  {
3906  /* Fixed CFAR Threshold Mode: Use constant threshold for all range bins */
3907  retVal = HWA_configCFARThresholdScale(obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.cfarCfg->thresholdScale);
3908  }
3909  if (retVal != 0)
3910  {
3911  goto exit;
3912  }
3913 #endif
3914 
3915 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
3916  retVal = HWA_configCDFCountThreshold(floor(CDF_CNT_THRES * cfg->staticCfg.numDopplerFFTBins / cfg->staticCfg.numBandsTotal));
3917  if (retVal != 0)
3918  {
3919  goto exit;
3920  }
3921 #endif
3922 
3923 exit:
3924  return(retVal);
3925 }

3944 static inline void DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configStateMachine(DSSHWACCRegs *ctrlBaseAddr, uint16_t numLoops, uint16_t paramStartIdx, uint16_t paramStopIdx)
3945 {
3946  /* Disable HWA */
3947  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->HWA_ENABLE, HWA_ENABLE_HWA_EN_END, HWA_ENABLE_HWA_EN_START, 0x0U);
3948 
3949  ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_RAM_LOOP = numLoops;
3950 
3951  ctrlBaseAddr->PARAM_RAM_IDX = ((uint32_t)paramStopIdx << 16) | (uint32_t)paramStartIdx;
3952 
3953  /* Enable HWA */
3954  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->HWA_ENABLE, HWA_ENABLE_HWA_EN_END, HWA_ENABLE_HWA_EN_START, 0x7U);
3955 
3956 }

4029 int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_process
4030 (
4031  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Handle handle,
4032  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg,
4033  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_OutParams *outParams
4034 )
4035 {
4036  uint16_t shuffleRAMBuf[256] = {0};
4037  volatile uint32_t startTime;
4038  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj;
4039  int32_t retVal = SystemP_SUCCESS;
4040 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4041  uint32_t rangeIdx;
4042 #endif
4043 #ifndef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4044 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4045  uint8_t cfarPingParam, cfarPongParam;
4046 #else
4047  uint8_t azimuthPingParam, azimuthPongParam;
4048 #endif
4049  uint8_t demodPingParam, demodPongParam;
4050  uint8_t localMaxPingParam, localMaxPongParam;
4051 #else
4052  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
4053 #endif
4054  uint32_t rangeBinIdx = 0U, mergedOBIdx = 0U;
4055  uint32_t dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress;
4056  uint32_t blockIdx = 0;
4057  uint16_t decompNumLoops, decompParamStart, decompParamStop;
4058  uint16_t dopplerAzimNumLoops, dopplerAzimParamStart, dopplerAzimParamStop;
4059  volatile DSSHWACCRegs * ctrlBaseAddr;
4060  uint16_t *shuffleRamBaseAddr;
4061  uint16_t shuffleLUTSize;
4062  uint32_t baseAddr, regionId;
4063  uint32_t processingTime;
4064 
4065  obj = (DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *)handle;
4066  if (obj == NULL)
4067  {
4068  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_EINVAL;
4069  goto exit;
4070  }
4071 
4072  ctrlBaseAddr = (DSSHWACCRegs *)(((HWA_Object *)obj->hwaHandle)->hwAttrs->ctrlBaseAddr);
4073  shuffleRamBaseAddr = (uint16_t *)gHwaRamCfg[HWA_RAM_TYPE_SHUFFLE_RAM].ramBaseAddress;
4074  shuffleLUTSize = (obj->numDopplerBins/obj->dopplerDemodCfg.numBandsTotal) * (uint16_t)sizeof (uint16_t);
4075 
4076  /* Set inProgress state */
4077  obj->inProgress = true;
4078 
4079  obj->numObjOut = 0;
4080 
4081  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
4082  baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(obj->edmaHandle);
4083  regionId = EDMA_getRegionId(obj->edmaHandle);
4084 
4085  /* decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress gets updated every block to fetch the compressed radar cube for next block.
4086  * This needs to be reset to the start address of radar cube data before the doppler processing starts.
4087  */
4088  obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress = (void*)cfg->hwRes.radarCube.data;
4089 
4090  decompNumLoops = obj->decompCfg.numLoops;
4091  decompParamStart = (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.decompStageHwaStateMachineCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
4092  decompParamStop = (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.decompStageHwaStateMachineCfg.paramSetStartIdx + (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.decompStageHwaStateMachineCfg.numParamSets - 1U;
4093 
4094  dopplerAzimNumLoops = cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock / 2U * (uint16_t)obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks;
4095  dopplerAzimParamStart = (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.dopplerStageHwaStateMachineCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
4096  dopplerAzimParamStop = (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.azimCfarStageHwaStateMachineCfg.paramSetStartIdx + (uint16_t)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.azimCfarStageHwaStateMachineCfg.numParamSets - 1U;
4097 
4098 #ifndef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4099  demodPingParam = cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.azimCfarStageHwaStateMachineCfg.paramSetStartIdx + cfg->staticCfg.numRxAntennas - 1U;
4100  demodPongParam = demodPingParam + (cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.azimCfarStageHwaStateMachineCfg.numParamSets / 2U);
4101 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4102  cfarPingParam = demodPingParam + 2U;
4103  cfarPongParam = demodPongParam + 2U;
4104  localMaxPingParam = cfarPingParam + 1U;
4105  localMaxPongParam = cfarPongParam + 1U;
4106 #else
4107  azimuthPingParam = demodPingParam + 1U;
4108  azimuthPongParam = demodPongParam + 1U;
4109  localMaxPingParam = demodPingParam + 2U;
4110  localMaxPongParam = demodPongParam + 2U;
4111 #endif
4112 #endif
4113 
4114  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configHWACommon(obj, cfg);
4115  if (retVal != 0)
4116  {
4117  goto exit;
4118  }
4119 
4120  /* Run block-wise */
4121  for(blockIdx = 0U; blockIdx < obj->decompCfg.numOuterBlocks; blockIdx++)
4122  {
4123  /* STAGE I (DECOMPRESSION) */
4124  /* Configure the HWA to perform decompression. */
4125  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configStateMachine(ctrlBaseAddr, decompNumLoops, decompParamStart, decompParamStop);
4126 
4127  /* Update the source address for the EDMA that brings in compressed data from L3 to HWA for decompression*/
4128  if(blockIdx != 0U)
4129  {
4130 
4131  obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress = (int32_t *)((uint8_t *)obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress +
4132  obj->decompCfg.outerBlockSizeCompressed);
4133 
4134  retVal = DPEDMA_updateAddressAndTrigger(obj->edmaHandle,
4135  (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress, /* src addr */
4136  0, /* don't update dest addr */
4137  (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PING].channel, /* param Id */
4138  false); /* don't trigger channel */
4139  if (retVal != 0)
4140  {
4141  goto exit;
4142  }
4143 
4144  retVal = DPEDMA_updateAddressAndTrigger(obj->edmaHandle,
4145  (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.decompEdmaToHwaStartAddress
4146  + ((uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.inputBytesPerBlock * (uint32_t)obj->decompCfg.numBlocksPerPing), /* src addr */
4147  0, /* don't update dest addr */
4148  (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PONG].channel, /* param Id */
4149  false); /* don't trigger channel */
4150  if (retVal != 0)
4151  {
4152  goto exit;
4153  }
4154 
4155  }
4156 
4157  /* Decomp (Ping) : Start ping DMA Transfer to bring compressed data from L3 to HWA for decompression */
4158  EDMA_setEvtRegion(baseAddr, regionId, (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PING].channel);
4159 
4160  /* Decomp (Pong) : Start pong DMA Transfer to bring compressed data from L3 to HWA for decompression */
4161  EDMA_setEvtRegion(baseAddr, regionId, (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PONG].channel);
4162 
4163  /* ObjectList Create (Pong) : Given the CFAR & local Maxima results, create an object list of the last block's pong stage.
4164  * Note: The following three operations will happen in parallel.
4165  DSP/DSS_CM4: Extract object list of the previous block's last pong stage.
4166  HWA : Decompression of the current block of range gates.
4167  EDMA : Movement of compressed data to the HWA from L3 and decompressed data from HWA to L3. */
4168  if(blockIdx != 0U)
4169  {
4170  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(obj, cfg, blockIdx - 1U, mergedOBIdx - 1U, rangeBinIdx - 1U);
4171  if (retVal != 0)
4172  {
4173  goto exit;
4174  }
4175  }
4176 
4177  /* Wait for EDMA completion indicating that the decompressed data has been moved to L3. */
4178 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4179  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->decompEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4180  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4181  {
4182  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4183  goto exit;
4184  }
4185 #else
4186  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_edmaDonePoll(baseAddr, regionId, cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.decompEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PONG].channel);
4187 #endif
4188 
4189  /* STAGE II (DOPPLER FFT, DEMOD, AZIM, OBJLIST) */
4190  /* Disable the HWA, Configure common registers, and re-enable the HWA to perform Doppler FFT and DDMA metric computation */
4191  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_configStateMachine(ctrlBaseAddr, dopplerAzimNumLoops, dopplerAzimParamStart, dopplerAzimParamStop);
4192 
4193  /* Reset the doppler In EDMA Start Address Variable. */
4194  dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress = (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.decompScratchBuf;
4195 
4196  for(mergedOBIdx = 0U; mergedOBIdx < obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks; mergedOBIdx++)
4197  {
4198 
4199  if(mergedOBIdx != 0U)
4200  {
4201  dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress = dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress + (DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_DOPPLERIO_INPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE *
4202  cfg->staticCfg.numRxAntennas * obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock * cfg->staticCfg.numChirps);
4203 
4204  /* Update the source address for the EDMA that brings in decompressed data from L3 to HWA for doppler FFT */
4205  retVal = DPEDMA_updateAddressAndTrigger(obj->edmaHandle,
4206  (uint32_t)dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress, /* src addr */
4207  0, /* don't update dest addr */
4208  (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PING].channel, /* param Id */
4209  false); /* don't trigger channel */
4210  if (retVal != 0)
4211  {
4212  goto exit;
4213  }
4214 
4215  retVal = DPEDMA_updateAddressAndTrigger(obj->edmaHandle,
4216  (uint32_t)(dopInEDMAtoHWAStartAddress + (DPU_DOPPLERHWADDMA_DOPPLERIO_INPUT_BYTESPERSAMPLE * cfg->staticCfg.numRxAntennas)), /* src addr */
4217  0, /* don't update dest addr */
4218  (uint8_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PONG].channel, /* param Id */
4219  false); /* don't trigger channel */
4220  if (retVal != 0)
4221  {
4222  goto exit;
4223  }
4224  }
4225 
4226  /* DopFFT and DDMA Metric (Ping) : Send the first decompressed range gate from L3 to HWA for Doppler FFT calculation
4227  (ping), for the first range bin in the block. */
4228  EDMA_setEvtRegion(baseAddr, regionId, (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PING].channel);
4229 
4230  /* Extract object list of the previous pong stage */
4231  /* ObjectList Create (Pong) : Given the CFAR & local Maxima results, create an object list of the current block's previous pong stage.
4232  * Note: The following operations are now to happen in parallel.
4233  DSP/DSS_CM4 : Extract object list of the previous block's last range gate (Pong)
4234  HWA : Doppler FFT, DDMA metric and Max Subband computation of the current ping range gate.
4235  EDMA: Movement of decompressed data from L3 to HWA (Ping) and movement of Max Subband from HWA to the DSP/DSS_CM4 (Ping). */
4236  if(mergedOBIdx != 0U)
4237  {
4238  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(obj, cfg, blockIdx, mergedOBIdx - 1U, rangeBinIdx - 1U);
4239  if (retVal != 0)
4240  {
4241  goto exit;
4242  }
4243  }
4244 
4245  /* In this loop we process all the range gates in the block of decompressed data. Note that the loop increments by
4246  * 2 indicating that 2 range gates (called ping (or even) and pong (or odd)) are processed in parallel. */
4247  for(rangeBinIdx = 0U; rangeBinIdx < cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock; rangeBinIdx+=2U)
4248  {
4249 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4250  rangeIdx = (((blockIdx * obj->decompCfg.mergedNumOuterBlocks) + mergedOBIdx) * obj->decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock) + rangeBinIdx;
4251 #endif
4252 
4253 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4254  insertStamp(0);
4255 #endif
4256  /* Extract object list of the previous pong stage */
4257  /* ObjectList Create (Pong) : Given the CFAR & local Maxima results, create an object list of the current block's previous pong stage.
4258  * Note: The following operations are now to happen in parallel.
4259  DSP/DSS_CM4 : Extract object list of the previous block's last range gate (Pong)
4260  HWA : Doppler FFT, DDMA metric and Max Subband computation of the current ping range gate.
4261  EDMA: Movement of decompressed data from L3 to HWA (Ping) and movement of Max Subband from HWA to the DSP/DSS_CM4 (Ping). */
4262  if(rangeBinIdx != 0U)
4263  {
4264  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(obj, cfg, blockIdx, mergedOBIdx, rangeBinIdx - 1U);
4265  if (retVal != 0)
4266  {
4267  goto exit;
4268  }
4269  }
4270 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4271  insertStamp(1);
4272 #endif
4273  /* Send out decompressed range bin to HWA for Doppler FFT calculation (pong) */
4274  EDMA_setEvtRegion(baseAddr, regionId, (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PONG].channel);
4275 
4276 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4277  /* Initialize histogram RAM here. */
4278  ctrlBaseAddr->MEM_INIT_START = HWA_APP_MEMINIT_HIST_EVEN_RAM | HWA_APP_MEMINIT_HIST_ODD_RAM;
4279 #endif
4280 
4281  /* Wait for ping data transfer of Max Suband Index. */
4282 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4283  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->maxSubbandEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle[PING], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4284  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4285  {
4286  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4287  goto exit;
4288  }
4289 #else
4290  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_edmaDonePoll(baseAddr, regionId, cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaMaxSubbandOut.pingPong[PING].channel);
4291 #endif
4292 
4293 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4294  insertStamp(2);
4295 #endif
4296  /* Note: The following operations are now to happen in parallel.
4297  DSP/DSS_CM4 : Program the shuffle LUT to rearrange the Doppler FFT output in HWA so that the empty band is removed and the antenna data is in the correct order.
4298  HWA : Doppler FFT, DDMA metric and Max Subband computation of the current pong range gate.
4299  EDMA: Movement of decompressed data from L3 to HWA (Pong), doppler FFT data from HWA SrcMemBank to DstMemBank after band-wise tanspose (Ping). */
4300  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_ConfigShuffleLUT((void *)&shuffleRamBaseAddr[0], obj, cfg, PING);
4301 
4302 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4303  insertStamp(3);
4304 #endif
4305  /* Trigger (SW Trigger) the execution of Demodulation (Ping) Paramsets. */
4306  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
4307 
4308  /* Wait for pong data transfer of Max Suband Index. */
4309 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4310  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->maxSubbandEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle[PONG], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4311  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4312  {
4313  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4314  goto exit;
4315  }
4316 #else
4317  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_edmaDonePoll(baseAddr, regionId, cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaMaxSubbandOut.pingPong[PONG].channel);
4318 #endif
4319 
4320 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4321  insertStamp(4);
4322 #endif
4323 
4324  /* Note: The following operations are now to happen in parallel.
4325  DSP/DSS_CM4 : Compute the shuffle LUT values with PONG max Subabnd Indices.
4326  HWA : Demodulation, Azimuth FFT over the ping Doppler FFT, and CFAR, Local Max on the ping azimuth output.
4327  EDMA: Movement of Doppler FFT data from HWA SrcMemBank to DstMemBank after band-wise tanspose (Pong) and of Local Max, Azimuth FFT, CFAR and Demodulated Output from HWA to DSP/DSS_CM4 (Ping). */
4328  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_ConfigShuffleLUT(shuffleRAMBuf, obj, cfg, PONG);
4329 
4330 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4331  insertStamp(5);
4332 #endif
4333 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4334  /* Wait for Demod ping paramset done interrupt from HWA */
4335 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4336  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->demodHwaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4337  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4338  {
4339  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4340  goto exit;
4341  }
4342 #else
4343  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, demodPingParam);
4344 #endif
4345 #else
4346 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4347  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->azimFFTHwaDoneSemaHandle[PING], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4348  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4349  {
4350  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4351  goto exit;
4352  }
4353 #else
4354  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, azimuthPingParam);
4355 #endif
4356 #endif
4357 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4358  insertStamp(6);
4359 #endif
4360 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4361  /* Shuffle LUT is programmed here after the ping demodulation param is done so that shuffle LUT does not get overwritten with the pong values. */
4362  (void)memcpy((void *)&shuffleRamBaseAddr[0],(void*)((uint8_t *)shuffleRAMBuf + shuffleLUTSize), shuffleLUTSize);
4363 
4364  /* Wait for CFAR ping paramset done interrupt from HWA */
4365 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4366  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->cfarHwaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4367  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4368  {
4369  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4370  goto exit;
4371  }
4372 #else
4373  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, cfarPingParam);
4374 #endif
4375 
4376  /* Read ping CFAR peak reg count in HWA */
4377  obj->numCfarPeaksPing = CSL_FEXTR(ctrlBaseAddr->CFAR_PEAKCNT, CFAR_PEAKCNT_CFAR_PEAKCNT_END, CFAR_PEAKCNT_CFAR_PEAKCNT_START);
4378  if(obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.cfarCfg->variableThresholdMode != 0U)
4379  {
4380  /* Variable CFAR Threshold Mode: Update threshold for next pong range bin
4381  *
4382  * After processing the current ping range bin (rangeIdx), pre-configure the
4383  * HWA CFAR threshold for the next pong range bin (rangeIdx + 1) before
4384  * triggering its execution. This ensures the correct range-dependent threshold
4385  * is applied when the pong paramset runs.
4386  *
4387  * Ping-pong processing: While DSP extracts objects for ping, HWA processes pong
4388  * with its appropriately scaled threshold.
4389  */
4390  retVal = HWA_configCFARThresholdScale(
4391  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_getRangeDependentCfarThreshold(cfg, rangeIdx + 1U));
4392  if (retVal != 0)
4393  {
4394  goto exit;
4395  }
4396  }
4397  /* Trigger the execution of Azimuth Stage (Pong) Paramsets.
4398  This trigger is done later here since we need to read the CFAR peak count reg which cannot
4399  be done while another paramset is executing. Hence we cannot have any pong paramset running while we
4400  read the CFAR peak count register. The pong paramset can run while the DSP/DSS_CM4 is creating the object list at the ping side, hence the EDMA transferred is triggered next here. */
4401  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
4402 #endif
4403 
4404 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4405  insertStamp(7);
4406 #endif
4407 
4408 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4409 
4410  /* Configure Local Max Thresholds */
4411  DPU_DopplerProcHwa_configLocalMaxThresh(ctrlBaseAddr, cfg->staticCfg.numAzimFFTBins);
4412 
4413  /* Trigger LM ping param */
4414  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
4415 
4416  /* Clear Histogram RAM */
4417  ctrlBaseAddr->MEM_INIT_START = HWA_APP_MEMINIT_HIST_EVEN_RAM | HWA_APP_MEMINIT_HIST_ODD_RAM;
4418 
4419  /* Shuffle LUT is programmed here after the ping demodulation param is done so that shuffle LUT does not get overwritten with the pong values. */
4420  (void)memcpy((void *)&shuffleRamBaseAddr[0],(uint8_t *)shuffleRAMBuf + shuffleLUTSize, shuffleLUTSize);
4421 
4422  /* Trigger the execution of Demodulation Paramset.
4423  The pong paramset can run while the DSP/DSS_CM4 is creating the object list at the ping side, hence the EDMA transferred is triggered next here. */
4424  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
4425 #endif
4426 
4427 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4428  insertStamp(8);
4429 #endif
4430 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4431  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->localMaxHwaDoneSemaHandle[PING], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4432  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4433  {
4434  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4435  goto exit;
4436  }
4437 #else
4438  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, localMaxPingParam);
4439 #endif
4440 
4441 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4442  insertStamp(9);
4443 #endif
4444  /* Extract ping object list on the DSP/DSS_CM4 - In this function the intersection of the localmax and CFAR on the doppler Azimuth operations is computed and the detected object list is created.
4445  * Note: The following operations are now to happen in parallel.
4446  DSP/DSS_CM4 : Extract object list (ping)
4447  HWA : Demodulation, Azimuth FFT over the pong Doppler FFT, Local Max and CFAR on the azimuth output.
4448  EDMA: Movement of pong Azimuth FFT data from DSP/DSS_CM4 L2 to the HWA and of local max and CFAR from HWA to DSP/DSS_CM4.*/
4449  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(obj, cfg, blockIdx, mergedOBIdx, rangeBinIdx);
4450  if (retVal != 0)
4451  {
4452  goto exit;
4453  }
4454 
4455 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4456  insertStamp(10);
4457 #endif
4458  /* The following steps prepare for the next range bin of the block. */
4459  if(rangeBinIdx != cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock-2U)
4460  {
4461  /* Send out decompressed range bin to HWA for Doppler FFT calculation (ping) */
4462  EDMA_setEvtRegion(baseAddr, regionId, (uint32_t)cfg->hwRes.edmaCfg.dopplerEdmaCfg.edmaIn.pingPong[PING].channel);
4463  }
4464 
4465 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4466  /* Wait for Demod pong paramset done interrupt from HWA */
4467 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4468  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->azimFFTHwaDoneSemaHandle[PONG], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4469  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4470  {
4471  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4472  goto exit;
4473  }
4474 #else
4475  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, azimuthPongParam);
4476 #endif
4477 
4478  DPU_DopplerProcHwa_configLocalMaxThresh(ctrlBaseAddr, cfg->staticCfg.numAzimFFTBins);
4479 
4480  /* Trigger LM pong param */
4481  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->FW2HWA_TRIG_0, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_END, FW2HWA_TRIG_0_FW2HWA_TRIGGER_0_START, 1U);
4482 #endif
4483 
4484 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4485  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->localMaxHwaDoneSemaHandle[PONG], SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4486  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
4487  {
4488  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_ESEMASTATUS;
4489  goto exit;
4490  }
4491 #else
4492  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_hwaDonePoll(ctrlBaseAddr, localMaxPongParam);
4493 #endif
4494 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4495  /* Read pong CFAR peak reg count in HWA */
4496  obj->numCfarPeaksPong = CSL_FEXTR(ctrlBaseAddr->CFAR_PEAKCNT, CFAR_PEAKCNT_CFAR_PEAKCNT_END, CFAR_PEAKCNT_CFAR_PEAKCNT_START);
4497  if((obj->cfarAzimFFTCfg.cfarCfg->variableThresholdMode != 0U) &&
4498  (rangeBinIdx != (cfg->staticCfg.decompCfg.rangeBinsPerBlock - 2U)))
4499  {
4500  /* Variable CFAR Threshold Mode: Update threshold for next ping range bin
4501  *
4502  * After processing the current pong range bin (rangeIdx + 1), pre-configure
4503  * the HWA CFAR threshold for the upcoming ping range bin (rangeIdx + 2).
4504  * This maintains the ping-pong pipeline with correct range-dependent thresholds.
4505  *
4506  * Note: Skip the update on the second-to-last iteration (rangeBinIdx ==
4507  * rangeBinsPerBlock - 2) to avoid accessing beyond the LUT bounds, as
4508  * rangeIdx + 2 would exceed numRangeBins for the current outer block.
4509  */
4510  retVal = HWA_configCFARThresholdScale(
4511  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_getRangeDependentCfarThreshold(cfg, rangeIdx + 2U));
4512  if (retVal != 0)
4513  {
4514  goto exit;
4515  }
4516  }
4517 #endif
4518 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_DPU_TIMING
4519  insertStamp(11);
4520 #endif
4521  } /* End of RangeBins Per Block Loop. */
4522 
4523  } /* End of Merged Outer Blocks Loop. */
4524  } /* End of Outer Blocks Loop. */
4525 
4526  /* Extract object list of the last pong stage */
4527  if (obj->decompCfg.numOuterBlocks != 0U)
4528  {
4529  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_extractObjectList(obj, cfg, blockIdx - 1U, mergedOBIdx - 1U, rangeBinIdx - 1U);
4530  if (retVal != 0)
4531  {
4532  goto exit;
4533  }
4534  }
4535 
4536  outParams->numObjOut = obj->numObjOut;
4537  outParams->stats.numProcess++;
4538  processingTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime;
4539  outParams->stats.processingTime = (uint64_t)processingTime;
4540 
4541 exit:
4542  if (obj != NULL)
4543  {
4544  obj->inProgress = false;
4545  }
4546 
4547  return retVal;
4548 }

4564 int32_t DPU_DopplerProcHWA_deinit(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Handle handle)
4565 {
4566  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj *obj = NULL;
4567  int32_t retVal = 0;
4568 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4569  uint8_t index = 0U;
4570 #endif
4571  /* Sanity Check */
4572  obj = (DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Obj*)handle;
4573  if(obj == NULL)
4574  {
4575  retVal = DPU_DOPPLERPROCHWA_EINVAL;
4576  goto exit;
4577  }
4578 
4579  /* Delete Semaphores */
4580 #ifdef DOPPLERPROCHWADDMA_INTERRUPTS
4581  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->decompEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle);
4582  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->demodHwaDoneSemaHandle);
4583 #ifndef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4584  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->cfarHwaDoneSemaHandle);
4585 #endif
4586 
4587  for(index = 0U; index < 2U; index++)
4588  {
4589  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->maxSubbandEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle[index]);
4590 #ifdef ENABLE_HISTOGRAM_BASED_DOP_AZIM_DETECTION
4591  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->azimFFTHwaDoneSemaHandle[index]);
4592 #endif
4593  SemaphoreP_destruct(&obj->localMaxHwaDoneSemaHandle[index]);
4594  }
4595 #endif
4596 exit:
4597  return retVal;
4598 }
